stream.name: ai_events_stream
stream.sql: CREATE STREAM ai_events_stream (camera_id STRING, type STRING, confidence FLOAT, timestamp STRING, object_id BIGINT) WITH (DATASOURCE="cctv/ai/events/+/+", TYPE="mqtt", FORMAT="json", SHARED="true")

rules.sql: SELECT camera_id, type, confidence, timestamp, object_id FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'person', 'helmet', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{INTRUSION_CONFIDENCE}}

SELECT camera_id, MAX(confidence) AS max_confidence, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, window_end() AS detected_until FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'person', 'helmet', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{INTRUSION_CONFIDENCE}} GROUP BY camera_id, TUMBLINGWINDOW(ss, 5) HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{PERSIST_HIT_COUNT}}

SELECT camera_id, type, confidence, timestamp, object_id, 'critical' AS severity FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{CRITICAL_CONFIDENCE}}
